method: Twelve Mobbin MCP searches across the original design and the research-profile revision; all 35 returned previews inspected.

searches.query: Research institution hero with large typography, a scientist portrait and university affiliation
Research publications index with article titles, authors, dates and category filters
About page with a large editorial portrait and biographical text arranged in columns
Research publication archive with large linked article titles, publication years and understated dividers
University or scientific research laboratory website with an editorial typographic layout
Personal portfolio website navigation with a compact name and section links
Minimal contact footer with a large name, email address and social links
Read.cv profile with biography, experience and links on a narrow screen
Research publication list with conference names in a narrow column and paper titles and authors in a wider column
About section for an individual with a compact portrait, biography, and professional links
Research interests section with subject names aligned in a typographic grid
Read.cv personal profile with biography, work experience, projects and external links

decisions.observation: Compact identity details introduce a continuous professional record.
decisions.application: A restrained name, original portrait and profile links occupy the desktop identity column. Biography and publications share the wider reading column.

decisions.observation: Publication entries consistently separate venue, title and authors.
decisions.application: Each paper uses a narrow venue column and a larger linked serif title, with authors beneath. Publications immediately follow the introduction and focus topics.

decisions.observation: The directory maintains consistent column starts across rows of unequal text lengths.
decisions.application: Current focus uses equal grid tracks, with three, two or one columns determined by available reading width.

design.layout: Compact identity column on the left; biography, focus and publication record on the right. Research directions, news, service, talks and teaching continue on the same reading alignment. Tablet and mobile stack into a single reading column.
wireframe: Portrait     Current focus: three aligned columns
principles: Publication titles carry the strongest visual emphasis.
Every original text block and link remains available.
Reading order and navigation order agree.
No decorative marks or background panels; boundaries separate publication entries.
design.review: Replaced the oversized name, large portrait, dark research band and wrapping focus list. The first paper is visible in the initial 1440 by 1000 desktop viewport. Mobile keeps the full biography and stacks focus topics into one aligned list.
